summary: Phase 81.79 Controlled Auto-Scroll + Sticky Doc Header - All testable features verified. (1) Page load: window.scrollY=0 (no auto-scroll). (2) Start/Next buttons trigger controlled scroll. (3) Sticky doc header stays visible at top=160px when scrolling. (4) Field click does NOT change scroll. (5) Checkbox/radio click does NOT change scroll. (6) Enter on single-line text advances to next field. (7) Multi-line textarea not tested (no textarea in test doc). (8) Doc switching via sidebar not tested (single-doc package).
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: scrollToken prop (line 85) - scroll effect keyed ONLY on scrollToken, not activeFieldId
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: useEffect (lines 449-512) - scrollToken===0 returns early, preventing scroll on initial render
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: Container onKeyDown (lines 1675-1695) - Enter advances for INPUT (text/date/number), skips TEXTAREA and BUTTON
✅ InteractiveDocumentViewer.js: Per-field handleKeyDown (lines 894-899) - e.preventDefault() only for !isMultiline, allowing multi-line newlines
✅ PackageDocSection.js: Sticky header CSS 'sticky top-[210px] sm:top-40 z-20' when isActive (line 163)
✅ PackagePublicLinkView.js: prevDocIndexRef tracks previous doc index (lines 107-126)
✅ PackagePublicLinkView.js: Doc switch scrolls to new doc card, skips initial mount (lines 109-114)
